sources.entry: littleguys - WhatsApp-style app for talking to your AI agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and any ACP agent).

summary.one_liner: littleguys is a free, open-source macOS app that gives your AI agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and other ACP agents) WhatsApp-style chat threads, with a menu-bar sprite that shows which agent needs you.
keywords: run ai agents on my mac
talk to my coding agent from phone
summary.what_it_does: littleguys is a macOS app (macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon and Intel) that presents each AI agent as a contact with its own chat threads. The sidebar lists agents as cards, with streaming replies, tool-call chips, attachments, and approve/deny controls for commands. A menu-bar sprite and a popover show each agent's status (idle, working, new reply, needs you, offline) with a last-message preview and quick reply. The Routines feature runs cron-style jobs with friendly schedules, run-now and run history, with results landing in a thread. It can connect to several OpenClaw gateways at once, discovered on the Tailscale tailnet or LAN, and to Hermes Agent, Claude Code sessions on the Mac, and ACP agents started locally or reached over WebSocket. The README also describes a companion iPhone app that pairs with the Mac via QR code and end-to-end encryption.
use_cases: chat with several AI coding agents in one window
see which AI agent is waiting for my approval from the menu bar
follow and reply to Claude Code sessions running in my terminal
schedule recurring agent tasks with cron-style routines
manage OpenClaw gateways on my Mac, tailnet, or LAN
reach my local AI agents from an iPhone
how_to_run: Or download the .dmg from the Releases page on GitHub
Building from source: curl -fsSL <install script URL> | bash (the URL is blank in the README)
notable: Unified chat for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code and any ACP agent, each agent shown as a contact
Menu-bar sprite and popover show live status of every agent across gateways
Follows Claude Code sessions already running in the terminal via a littleguys plugin
Connects to multiple OpenClaw gateways at once, discovered over Tailscale and Bonjour
iPhone companion pairs by QR code with end-to-end encrypted sessions
caveats: macOS only; requires macOS 13 or later
Notifications do not jump to the thread when clicked (known gap)
Codex and other ACP agents running in a terminal do not appear; littleguys only sees sessions it starts itself, unlike Claude Code
Per-agent browser isolation is soft: a managed Chrome profile plus an AGENTS.md instruction, since OpenClaw has no per-agent browser binding
Phone notifications go through littleguys-relay, a separate service
